# Draugr Fang

Internal ID: BowDraugrFang | Type: Bow | Source: Forge | Usage: Ranged weapon | Crafting Materials: Ancient bark x15, Silver x30, Deer hide x6, Guck x6 | Attack speed: 0.8 s + 2.5 s draw time | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Draugr Fang is the fourth bow and made during the Silver Age. Its primary attack fires arrows and charging the attack increases accuracy, damage and velocity of the arrow. It does not have a secondary attack.
It also adds poison damage to the arrows.

## Notes

• The poison effect from the bow stacks with that of the poison arrows.
• The glow effect of the bow makes the player slightly easier to detect while sneaking.
